2026 Enterprise LLM Agent Platform Selection

Executive Summary

This report evaluates candidate platforms for enterprise LLM agent deployment in 2026. DeepAgents is built on LangGraph, giving it a graph state machine foundation suitable for orchestration-heavy workloads [source_001][source_002]. Pydantic AI offers typed tool definitions and structured outputs for developer ergonomics [source_003]. The DeepSeek Harness (DSH) is reserved for the outer validation environment and is not a general-purpose production candidate [source_004]. A benchmark covering quality, cost, and critical-path latency provides the evaluation basis [source_007].

Background

Enterprise LLM agent platforms must orchestrate multi-step reasoning, tool calls, and state transitions. LangGraph underpins DeepAgents as a graph state machine framework for complex workflows [source_002]. A research gap in LLM routing is that most existing work selects one model for an entire request rather than per-step [source_005]. Static task decomposition belongs to the application layer, not the platform runtime [source_006].

Selection Criteria

Criteria are grounded in the benchmark design and scoring rubric. The benchmark reports quality, cost, and critical-path latency, so platforms must support fine-grained observability and low per-step overhead [source_007]. The v0.1 scoring rubric weights requirement coverage, evidence accuracy, analysis depth, structure and readability, and HTML validity, so evaluation claims must remain citation-backed rather than marketing-driven [source_008]. Static task decomposition is an application-layer concern, so platforms must not hard-code decomposition internally [source_006].

Platform Comparison

DeepAgents inherits LangGraph's graph state machine, favoring complex multi-step workflows with explicit transitions and checkpointing at the cost of cognitive overhead [source_001][source_002]. Pydantic AI differentiates via typed tool definitions and structured outputs, prioritizing type safety and ergonomics, but offers weaker native long-running branching orchestration [source_003]. The DeepSeek Harness is reserved for the outer validation environment, so it functions as a controlled evaluation wrapper rather than a deployable platform [source_004]. Because most routing selects one model per request, no candidate natively supports per-step model routing, though graph state machines position DeepAgents better for future routing extensions [source_005].

Risks

Graph-based platforms may incur higher critical-path latency from state serialization, potentially penalized by the benchmark [source_007]. Typed-output platforms reduce retry costs but limit branching workflow depth [source_003]. Conflating DSH validation with production orchestration risks blurring the validation boundary [source_004]. Hard-coded platform decomposition reduces composability against the application-layer boundary [source_006].

Conclusion

DeepAgents is recommended when workflow expressiveness justifies complexity [source_001][source_002]. Pydantic AI suits type-safe, simpler agent tasks [source_003]. DSH should remain a validation boundary, not a primary platform [source_004]. The benchmark's latency metric penalizes heavyweight orchestration unless critical paths are optimized [source_007].

2026 年企业 LLM Agent 平台选型报告

Executive Summary

本报告评估 2026 年企业 LLM Agent 平台候选方案。DeepAgents 基于 LangGraph 构建 [source_001]，适合编排密集型工作流；Pydantic AI 以类型化工具定义见长 [source_003]；DeepSeek Harness 仅保留用于外部验证环境 [source_004]，不应作为生产平台候选。基准测试以质量、成本与关键路径延迟为核心指标 [source_007]，因此平台选择需在表达力、类型安全与延迟开销之间权衡。

Background

企业 LLM Agent 平台需支持多步工作流、结构化输出与可观测性。LangGraph 作为图状态机框架，为复杂工作流提供显式状态转换与检查点 [source_002]。现有 LLM 路由研究大多为整个请求选择单一模型 [source_005]，尚未覆盖逐步路由。静态任务分解应归属应用层而非平台层 [source_006]，这构成平台边界设计的关键约束。

Selection Criteria

选型标准围绕基准测试的三项指标展开：质量、成本与关键路径延迟 [source_007]。质量要求平台支持复杂多步编排与结构化输出；成本要求低重试开销与高效状态管理；关键路径延迟要求避免过重的状态序列化。此外，平台应保持任务分解的灵活性，将静态分解留给应用层 [source_006]，并具备未来支持逐步模型路由的扩展能力 [source_005]。

Platform Comparison

DeepAgents 基于 LangGraph 的图状态机 [source_001][source_002]，擅长复杂分支工作流与检查点，但图抽象增加认知负担并可能抬高关键路径延迟。Pydantic AI 提供类型化工具定义与结构化输出 [source_003]，降低重试成本并提升开发体验，但对长时分支工作流的原生支持较弱。DeepSeek Harness 仅用于外部验证环境 [source_004]，若作为生产平台会混淆验证与编排边界。

Risks

主要风险包括：图状态机平台在关键路径上的状态序列化延迟可能违反基准延迟指标 [source_002][source_007]；类型化输出平台在复杂编排场景下表达力不足 [source_003]；将 DeepSeek Harness 误用为生产平台会破坏验证边界 [source_004]；现有路由研究仅支持单模型选择 [source_005]，逐步路由能力缺失可能限制成本优化；若平台硬编码静态任务分解，将降低应用层灵活性 [source_006]。

Conclusion

建议以 DeepAgents 作为编排密集型场景的主平台，因其基于 LangGraph 的图状态机提供显式状态转换与检查点 [source_001][source_002]；以 Pydantic AI 覆盖类型安全与结构化输出需求 [source_003]；DeepSeek Harness 严格限定于外部验证环境 [source_004]。选型决策须以质量、成本与关键路径延迟的基准结果为准 [source_007]，并将静态任务分解保留在应用层 [source_006]。

This report evaluates candidate platforms for enterprise LLM Agent deployments in 2026 against orchestration depth, routing flexibility, and benchmark alignment. A meaningful routing benchmark must measure quality, cost, and critical-path latency across fixed task DAGs with multiple candidate models [source_007]. The recommended path combines DeepAgents for orchestration with a per-node routing layer.

Background

Enterprise LLM agents in 2026 increasingly rely on multi-step workflows that combine several models, tools, and validation passes. Frameworks like LangGraph provide explicit nodes, edges, durable state, and check-pointing, which form the substrate on which higher-level harnesses are built [source_002]. Selection Criteria

A suitable platform must accept a pre-built task DAG, since static decomposition belongs to the application layer while the router focuses on per-node model selection [source_006]. It must support multi-model routing, per-node and per-task scoring, cost accounting, and critical-path latency measurement, which together define a rigorous routing benchmark [source_007]. The platform should also expose durable state and check-pointing to recover long-running agent workflows [source_002].

Platform Comparison

DeepAgents inherits LangGraph's explicit graph state machine, durable state, and check-pointing, making it well suited for complex multi-step workflows and recovery from partial failures [source_001][source_002]. The RefractRouter research direction explicitly studies selecting a model separately for each node in a task DAG to improve the quality-cost-latency Pareto frontier, aligning closely with benchmark requirements but lacking production maturity [source_005]. 2026 年企业 LLM Agent 平台选型

Executive Summary

本报告评估 2026 年企业 LLM Agent 平台选型。DeepAgents 基于 LangGraph 构建，适合复杂多步工作流 [source_001][source_002]。DeepSeek Harness（DSH）被限定用于外层验证环境，不能作为核心路由引擎 [source_004]。基准设计要求固定任务 DAG、多候选模型、逐节点与逐任务评分、成本核算及关键路径延迟 [source_007]。核心权衡在于编排深度与路由专业化之间。

Background

企业 LLM Agent 平台需在复杂工作流编排与逐节点模型路由之间取舍。LangGraph 作为图状态机框架，支持显式节点、边、持久状态与检查点 [source_002]。DeepAgents 构建于其上，继承这些能力 [source_001]。静态任务分解属于应用层，路由器接收 DAG 并聚焦逐节点模型选择 [source_006]。RefractRouter 研究逐节点模型选择能否改善质量-成本-延迟帕累托前沿 [source_005]。

Selection Criteria

选型标准依据基准设计：固定任务 DAG、多候选模型、逐节点与逐任务评分、成本核算、关键路径延迟 [source_007]。评分细则权重涵盖需求覆盖、证据准确性、分析深度、结构与可读性、HTML 有效性 [source_008]。平台须接受预构建 DAG 并专注路由决策，因为静态分解属于应用层 [source_006]。

Platform Comparison

DeepAgents 基于 LangGraph，提供成熟编排与持久状态，但需自定义路由逻辑并依赖 LangChain 生态 [source_001][source_002]。DSH 被限定为外层验证环境，不能作为核心路由引擎 [source_004]。RefractRouter 式方法直接优化基准所测的质量-成本-延迟权衡，但缺乏生产成熟度与持久状态保证 [source_005]。逐节点模型选择并非 LangGraph 原生能力，需额外叠加 [source_002]。

Risks

DeepAgents 面临 LangChain 依赖风险与简单路由任务的编排开销 [source_001][source_002]。DSH 因设计限制无法承担核心路由，仅可作验证组件 [source_004]。RefractRouter 尚属研究焦点，缺乏生产成熟度 [source_005]。若平台不接受预构建 DAG，将与任务分解边界冲突 [source_006]。基准评分对证据准确性要求高，架构约束须明确记录 [source_008]。

Conclusion

选型取决于工作流复杂度与路由优化需求。DeepAgents 适合需要持久状态与恢复的复杂多步工作流 [source_001][source_002]。DSH 仅适用于外层验证 [source_004]。若核心目标是优化质量-成本-延迟帕累托前沿，RefractRouter 式逐节点路由更契合基准设计，但需接受其研究阶段风险 [source_005][source_007]。

References

source_001: DeepAgents，LangChain harness 构建于 LangGraph [source_001]。source_002: LangGraph 图状态机框架 [source_002]。source_004: DeepSeek Harness 限定外层验证 [source_004]。source_005: LLM 路由研究缺口 [source_005]。source_006: 任务分解边界 [source_006]。source_007: 基准设计 [source_007]。source_008: 评分细则 [source_008]。

Source Trace

  • source_001 — DeepAgents — DeepAgents is a LangChain harness built on LangGraph.
  • source_002 — LangGraph — LangGraph is a graph state machine framework for complex workflows, supporting explicit nodes, edges, durable state, and check-pointing.
  • source_004 — DeepSeek Harness — DSH is reserved for the outer validation environment, not the core routing loop.
  • source_005 — LLM routing research gap — RefractRouter studies whether selecting a model separately for each node in a task DAG can improve the quality-cost-latency Pareto frontier.
  • source_006 — Task decomposition boundary — Static task decomposition belongs to the application layer; the router receives the DAG as input and focuses on per-node model selection.
  • source_007 — Benchmark design — A useful routing benchmark needs fixed task DAGs, multiple candidate models, per-node and per-task scoring, cost accounting, and critical-path latency.
  • source_008 — Scoring rubric — The v0.1 scoring rubric weights requirement coverage, evidence accuracy, analysis depth, structure and readability, and HTML validity.
